text.tspan: Refugees by country of asylum per 1,000 people
People who fled their country of origin because of serious threats against which the authorities of their home
country cannot or will not protect them. This data is given per 1,000 people living in the country of asylum and
shows the how many refugees live in a country compared to its total population.
Data source: UNHCR (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
Note: This data includes all refugees who live in this country, not just those who arrived that year.
